title: Signature CPU Atlas — Atlas concept
description: The Signature CPU Atlas is Manon's original silicon cartography: every tab CPU-Z has, drawn as an explorable map of the machine. Each reading carries a confidence note saying how it was measured, so the Atlas never states a guess as a fact.

title: Signature CPU Atlas — Processor map
description: The processor map lays out identity, topology, and live clocks on one canvas, with each core's current speed as a bar. Cores that never boost get flagged, which is how the Atlas spots a misbehaving scheduler or a hot core.

title: Signature CPU Atlas — Clock arithmetic
description: The Atlas shows the clock equation — bus times multiplier equals core speed — with the live numbers plugged in, updating as boost moves. Watching the equation breathe is the fastest way to learn how modern boost actually behaves.
